item.title: Bandcamp bans AI music uploads with new generative AI policy
item.description: Bandcamp AI music ban blocks tracks made wholly or largely with generative AI, bans AI impersonation, and adds reporting-based removals. Dated Jan 13, 2026.

item.title: Sexsomnia – Forbidden (Digital EP – Sexsomnia)
item.description: Sexsomnia is a Montreal, Canada–based trio that has released several singles, EPs, and even a full-length album since 2022.

item.title: Rayon release "Shopping B/W Running" single & video
item.description: Rayon’s "Shopping B/W Running" single gets a new "Running" video. The two-track release is out on Bandcamp and 7" via Little Cloud Records.

item.title: Moby drops new version "When It’s Cold I’d Like To Die" ahead of 23rd LP
item.description: Moby releases his 23rd studio album "Future Quiet" on February 20, 2026 via BMG, led by a new version of "When It’s Cold I’d Like To Die".

item.title: Back From The Wave + Umatik – Tokyo Dream (Digital EP – Space Factory Records)
item.description: "Tokyo Dream" emerged in late 2025 as a collaboration between French artists Back From The Wave and Umatik.

item.title: I WANT MY MTV!
item.description: MTV ended their transmissions at 6 AM on December 31st 2025, and it is hard not to appreciate or acknowledge the impact MTV had on me growing up.

item.title: Siva Six launch 20 year anniversary video
item.description: Greek dark electro duo Siva Six mark 20 years with the anniversary video "20 Years Siva Six - fraters and sorors edition" on their official YouTube channel.

item.title: Oberer Totpunkt compiles 19 tracks on "Feuer"
item.description: German dark electronic duo Oberer Totpunkt release "Feuer", a 19-track Danse Macabre compilation of live-tested songs from the Epitaph tour, out late 2025.

item.title: Rotersand Interview: ‘We make it difficult for ourselves’
item.description: The latest Rotersand album, “Don’t Become The Thing You Hated”, was released last year on Trisol and Metropolis Records. I spoke with Krischan J.E. Wesenberg.
